text:
Juniper planning notes (3–10 Nov) cover 26 modules and record these corrected values: feed ttl_s 210; checkout ttl_s 450 and retry_limit 7; tenant retry_limit 5; shipping max_workers 32 and timeout_s 75; pricing ttl_s 210; profile max_workers 6; indexer queue_depth 280; billing queue_depth 210 and batch_size 750; cache queue_depth 90; sync retry_limit 8; gateway max_workers 12.

Assignments: returns to alpha; alerts, indexer, shipping, and media to delta; pricing and archive to gamma; billing to beta.

Constraints: sync must not depend on tenant, and there must be no dependency path from checkout to feed, reports to billing, or metrics to catalog. Shipping and webhooks, billing and media, media and reports, and archive and backup must not share workers. Rollout order: pricing before backup, catalog before upload, shipping before reports, profile before checkout.

Open items: security and budget reviews are pending, the Rust rewrite and shared metrics library are deferred, and legacy exporter retirement is under review.
